en.headline: Red flags hoisted at Stanley, Big Wave Bay and Clear Water Bay beaches
en.dek: Leisure and Cultural Services Department cites big waves; beachgoers advised not to swim at the three sites in Southern and Sai Kung districts.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said red flags had been hoisted on Tuesday at Stanley Main Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District, and at Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung District, because of big waves.
The department advised beachgoers not to swim at these locations. Red flags indicate that conditions are dangerous for swimming.
The notice was issued at about 9.30am. No other weather warnings were in force from the Hong Kong Observatory at the time of publication.

zh.headline: 赤柱正灘、大浪灣及清水灣第二灣泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署因大浪關係懸掛紅旗，呼籲市民勿在港島南區及西貢區這三個泳灘游泳。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，由於大浪關係，周二已在港島南區的赤柱正灘泳灘及大浪灣泳灘，以及西貢區的清水灣第二灣泳灘懸掛紅旗。
署方呼籲泳客勿在這些泳灘游泳。紅旗表示該處游泳有危險。
有關公告於約上午9時30分發出。截至刊出時，天文台並無其他天氣警告生效。
